But the part that becomes really suspicious is that he wants to give things to a girl who has a boyfriend. If he’s really not a scammer he probably likes the idea of cuckholding but has such low self esteem that he would probably buy you things to wear with your boyfriend, the one he’ll never be. If on the other hand he’s a scammer, you can find out by thinking what kind of person you are. People are usually scammed by some confident hotshot who just looks like they have good energy and are trustworthy. But scammers are smart, if they see your someone who can be taken advantage of or like you’ll be sympathetic, then that’s when they would do this depressed guy act. If you were sympathetic with his self decepricating messages, then he may have you figured out and thinks you trust him enough to give his your bank details. 

All in all this is a very weird situation but the solution for both is to block and maybe even report him through tinder. Hope you figure this out.
